english.note: For a person's general temperament or habitual mood, this is the all-purpose everyday choice.

exampleSentences.english: They have a very easygoing disposition.

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's usual way of thinking, behaving, and reacting.

exampleSentences.english: Their temperament is easygoing, and they get along with everyone.

exampleSentences.english: Their being easygoing makes them easy to get along with.
